patterns.note: High-contrast color blocking is used to delineate major sections, transitioning from a dark green/black content area to a vibrant orange footer.
Asymmetrical two-column layout for case study entries, featuring large media (images or videos) on one side and concise text descriptions on the other.
Prominent, oversized serif typography is used for the brand name and section titles, creating a distinctive and authoritative feel, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
Content sections and individual elements (like case study titles and images) reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll.
The site uses a full-bleed, immersive video or canvas hero section that sets a mystical tone before transitioning to a dark-themed content area.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero section utilizes a video or canvas animation to create an immersive, dynamic introduction. The navigation bar is initially transparent over this hero and then transforms to a solid background with a subtle sticky effect as the user scrolls down.

Scroll-triggered animations are employed to progressively reveal content sections and individual elements. As the user scrolls, elements fade into view or slide up from the bottom, enhancing engagement and guiding attention through the page.

The site uses distinct, high-contrast background colors for different major sections (dark green/black for main content, vibrant orange for the footer) to create clear visual breaks and emphasize content hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, decorative serif headings (~4-5x body) establish a strong brand presence, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a comfortable rhythm within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a mystical, wizard-themed video/canvas hero immediately sets a unique and memorable tone. This, combined with the bold, high-contrast color palette of deep green and vibrant orange, and the ornate serif typography for branding, creates a strong, almost fantastical brand identity that stands apart from typical agency sites.
